# Target 56 frontier

## Robust theorem

If a physical bad kernel is bounded entrywise by a finite irreducible envelope
`B`, then the Perron weight of `B` controls every admissible row:

```text
Q <= B,  B V_B = rho(B) V_B  =>  Q V_B <= rho(B) V_B.
```

For the four-channel star, `rho(B)=0.002430277501841998`. The available
additive weighted slack is `q_critical-q`, and the relative multiplicative
slack is `q_critical/q-1`. A symmetric charged-state persistence or tunneling
mass is allowed only below the exact budget computed in the results JSON.

## First open physical implication

Prove entrywise or directly weighted upper envelopes for the complete
normalized continuous, center, cut/orbit, integer-topology, persistence, and
tunneling rows. The abstract robust optimization is closed; its nonlinear
Yang--Mills premises are not.

Claim ceiling: C2 robust finite multichannel theorem.
